[38;5;255mThe statistic is based on a difference or ratio; by default, for difference-based statistics, the
explanatory variable is subtracted in the order "2nd Lt" - "Flight Officer", or divided in the order
"2nd Lt" / "Flight Officer" for ratio-based statistics. To specify this order yourself, supply
`order = c("2nd Lt", "Flight Officer")` to the calculate() function.[39m
